context: You are at Wyrm’s Rock by the entrance to the Lower City; Mizora is present in human form and Wyll reacts to his father (Ravengard) being struck down or taken away. Wyll is distraught and accuses Mizora, who answers with a knowing, smiles and a blend of faux sympathy and amusement while claiming to have admired his father. Mizora hints Ravengard may not be truly lost and tells Wyll to meet her back at the camp, using that mystery and her information as leverage. (In related scenes at camp she presses that leverage into an explicit pact: save his father by agreeing to her terms, or refuse and face his death.)
